summary: Round-2 audit of trimal/1.5.1 (16 changed files, all under archives/t/trimal/**, single software; no forbidden files, no file:// or mirror domains). Deception checks clean: test_package/test.sh really executes the installed trimal/readal/statal binaries (version smoke, -nogaps and -gt output diffs, missing-input negative control, readal -info, statal -sgc); all assertion strings/formats were verified against upstream v1.5.1 source (rwAlignment.cpp '## Total sequences'/'## Alignment length' printed to cout via readAl -info; statal -sgc zero-based row output matches awk $1/$2 checks for tiny.fasta 50%/25%; missing input sets appearErrors and returns -1, so the negative control is real). The claimed -gt 0.6 expected output was validated against upstream source: main.cpp does gapThreshold = 1 - atof(...), so dropping the 50%-gap column to yield ACGT/A-GT/ACGT/ACGT is correct. Upstream regression evidence independently verified: scripts/generate_trimmed_msas.sh contains exactly 504 trimal calls (84 inputs x 6 modes; the 84 inputs are exactly the set appearing in the log), compare_trimmed_msas.sh echoes 'Compared' only after a successful diff, and reports/upstream-tests.log contains 504 distinct successful comparisons with 0 FAIL/ERROR (only upstream WARNING/blank lines before the documented marker). conandata.yml sha256 58751054861b152e92214ff8c01a132071230614e8e777a7c9280d03648cde3b was independently confirmed by downloading https://github.com/inab/trimal/archive/refs/tags/v1.5.1.tar.gz (byte-identical hash), and manifest.yaml upstream_commit d637091 matches the v1.5.1 tag via GitHub API. Recipe quality per R26/R32/R33/R37/R38/R39: compiler taken from tools.build:compiler_executables (no bare CC/CXX env), version = upstream 1.5.1, commands.json present at software level with type=tool, official HTTPS GitHub tag source, no mirror prefixes in conandata. All four round-1 fixes independently confirmed: (1) set -euo pipefail in test_package/test.sh:12 and run_upstream_tests.sh:8; (2) os.environ.get('CONFIG_SHELL') or shutil.which('bash') or '/data/service/hnp/bin/bash' with import shutil in conanfile.py:60-61 and test_package/conanfile.py:26-27; (3) NOTE header on the first three lines of reports/upstream-tests.log explaining assembly from the generate then compare runs with marker at line 7248; (4) reports/test-report.md section 5.4 replaced with actual W3/audit status. Verdict pass: P0=0, P1=0, no new P2/P3 raised.
